name: Industrials and materials (from the Claude run of 27 companies, prices to 2 Nov 2026)
status: Draft: tags, members and reasons copied from the Claude run page of 2 Nov 2026 (engine v4.11.1); keys from Fiscal.ai companies_list (4 Nov 2026) or the shipped universes; not yet reviewed by the user. Sales channels not filled.

flow_control_and_fluid_handling.label: Flow control and fluid handling
flow_control_and_fluid_handling.def: Pumps, valves, actuators, seals and dispensing equipment for process industries; a large share is replacement and service.

defence_primes_and_diversified_a_d.label: Defence primes and diversified A&D
defence_primes_and_diversified_a_d.def: Prime contractors whose largest customer is a government defence budget, and diversified aerospace and defence groups.

route_based_recurring_services.label: Route-based recurring services
route_based_recurring_services.def: Uniform rental, pest control, hygiene, cleaning and facility services delivered on regular routes or under service contracts; revenue recurs, capital is mostly route vehicles and garment or product stock.

industrial_mro_distribution.label: Industrial MRO distribution
industrial_mro_distribution.def: Distributors of maintenance, repair and operating supplies, fasteners, bearings, electrical and industrial products to manufacturers, contractors and institutions.

building_products.label: Building products
building_products.def: Makers of roofing, insulation, siding, decking, drainage, fixtures, HVAC equipment and structural building products sold through distributors and contractors.

diversified_industrial_manufacturers.label: Diversified industrial manufacturers
diversified_industrial_manufacturers.def: Decentralised groups of many niche engineered-product businesses (pumps, fluid, marking, welding-free tools, sensors, software) with no single end market above about a third of sales; growth by acquisition.

tools_welding_and_cutting.label: Tools, welding and cutting
tools_welding_and_cutting.def: Welding and cutting equipment and consumables, hand and power tools and cutting tools sold to industrial, construction and automotive customers through distributors, dealers and direct.

electrical_equipment_and_automation.label: Electrical equipment and automation
electrical_equipment_and_automation.def: Electrical distribution and protection equipment, power management, thermal and power systems for data centres, industrial automation and controls sold to utilities, data-centre, industrial and building customers.

industrial_gases.label: Industrial gases
industrial_gases.def: Oxygen, nitrogen, hydrogen and other gases supplied under long take-or-pay contracts through on-site plants, pipelines and merchant delivery; capital heavy, contract-protected returns.

metal_glass_and_rigid_containers.label: Metal, glass and rigid containers
metal_glass_and_rigid_containers.def: Beverage and food cans, glass bottles and jars, closures and steel containers sold under multi-year supply contracts to consumer-goods companies; high plant capital, pass-through of metal and energy costs.

labels_materials_and_flexible_packaging.label: Labels, materials and flexible packaging
labels_materials_and_flexible_packaging.def: Pressure-sensitive label materials, flexible films and packaging, identification products and consumer packaging converted from paper, film and foil.

life_science_tools_and_analytical_instru.label: Life science tools and analytical instruments
life_science_tools_and_analytical_instru.def: Analytical, laboratory and bioprocessing instruments, consumables and software sold to pharma, biotech, academic and industrial laboratories; a large recurring consumables and service base.

vertical_and_engineering_software.label: Vertical and engineering software
vertical_and_engineering_software.def: Application software for specific industries and engineering workflows sold by licence or subscription with high recurring revenue and low capital needs.

construction_concessions_and_infrastruct.label: Construction, concessions and infrastructure
construction_concessions_and_infrastruct.def: Civil engineering and building contractors that also own or operate infrastructure concessions (toll roads, airports, energy assets); earnings mix contracting margins and concession cash flows.
